achievements.name: One Bed One Bath
achievements.desc: Have at least one bed and one toilet for each Duplicant in the colony.

achievements.name: Outdoor Renovations
achievements.desc: Construct a building outside the initial starting biome.

achievements.name: To Pay the Bills
achievements.desc: Use a Duplicant's Skill Points to buy out an entire branch of the Skill Tree.

achievements.name: It's Not Raw
achievements.desc: Have a Duplicant eat any cooked meal prepared at an Electrical Grill or Gas Range.

achievements.name: Good Egg
achievements.desc: Hatch a new critter morph from an egg.

achievements.name: Royal Flush
achievements.desc: Replace all the Outhouses and Wash Basins in your colony with Lavatories and Sinks.

achievements.name: They Got Better
achievements.desc: Cure a sick Duplicant of disease.

achievements.name: Oxygen Not Occluded
achievements.desc: Distribute 1000kg of Oxygen using gas vents.

achievements.name: Red Light, Green Light
achievements.desc: Automate a building using sensors or switches from the Automation tab in the Build Menu.

achievements.name: Ghosts of Gravitas
achievements.desc: Recover a Database entry by inspecting facility ruins.

achievements.name: Turn of the Century
achievements.desc: Reach cycle 100 with at least one living Duplicant.

achievements.name: Slick
achievements.desc: Enter an oil biome for the first time.

achievements.name: Art Underground
achievements.desc: Have a Duplicant with the Masterworks skill paint a Masterpiece quality painting.

achievements.name: One Year, to be Exact
achievements.desc: Reach cycle 365.25 with a single colony.

achievements.name: And Nowhere to Go
achievements.desc: Have 8 Duplicants wear non-default clothing simultaneously.

achievements.name: No Place Like Clone
achievements.desc: Have at least 20 living Duplicants living in the colony at one time.

achievements.name: Pulling Back The Veil
achievements.desc: Reveal 80% of map by exploring outside the starting biome.

achievements.name: Totally Tubular
achievements.desc: Have Duplicants travel 10,000m by Transit Tube.

achievements.name: Tune Up For What?
achievements.desc: Perform 100 Tune Ups on power generators.

achievements.name: First Teleport of Call
achievements.desc: Teleport a Duplicant and defrost a Friend on another world.

achievements.name: Space Race
achievements.desc: Launch your first rocket into space.

achievements.name: Immovable Object
achievements.desc: Block a meteor from hitting your base using a Bunker Door.

achievements.name: Locavore
achievements.desc: Have Duplicants consume 400,000kcal of food without planting any seeds in Planter Boxes, Farm Tiles, or Hydroponic Farms.

achievements.name: Easy Livin'
achievements.desc: Have Auto Sweepers complete more deliveries to machines than Duplicants over 5 cycles.

achievements.name: Job Suitability
achievements.desc: For 10 cycles in a row, have every Duplicant in the colony complete at least one chore while wearing an Exosuit.

achievements.name: Get a Room
achievements.desc: Build at least one of each of the following rooms in a single colony: A Nature Reserve, a Hospital, a Recreation Room, a Great Hall, a Bedroom, a Washroom, a Greenhouse and a Stable.

achievements.name: Not 0K, But Pretty Cool
achievements.desc: Reduce the temperature of a building to 6 Kelvin.

achievements.name: Some Reservations
achievements.desc: Improve Duplicant Morale by designating 4 areas as Nature Reserves.

achievements.name: Super Sustainable
achievements.desc: Generate 240,000kJ of power without using coal, methane, petrol or wood generators.

achievements.name: Down the Hatch
achievements.desc: Produce 10 t of refined metal by ranching Smooth Hatches.

achievements.name: Honorary Doctorate
achievements.desc: Unlock every item in the Research Tree.

achievements.name: Radical Trip
achievements.desc: Have radbolts travel a cumulative 10 km.

achievements.name: Home Sweet Home
achievements.desc: Establish your permanent home by fulfilling the requirements of the Colonize Imperative.

achievements.name: Soft Launch
achievements.desc: Build a launchpad on a world without a teleporter.

achievements.name: Morale High Ground
achievements.desc: Have all Duplicants in a rocket survive in space for 10 cycles in a row with a morale of 25 or higher.

achievements.name: Carnivore
achievements.desc: Have Duplicants eat 400,000kcal of critter meat before the 100th cycle.

achievements.name: The Great Escape
achievements.desc: Ensure your colony's legacy by fulfilling the requirements of the Escape Imperative.

achievements.name: Sweeter Than Honey
achievements.desc: Extract Uranium from a Beeta hive without getting stung.

achievements.name: That's Rad!
achievements.desc: Run a Research Reactor at full capacity for 5 cycles.

achievements.name: Moovin' On Up
achievements.desc: Find and tame a Gassy Moo.

achievements.name: Cluster Conquest
achievements.desc: Land dupes or rovers on all worlds in the cluster.

achievements.name: Critter Whisperer
achievements.desc: Find and tame one of every critter species in the world. Default morphs only.

achievements.name: Most Valuable Bionic
achievements.desc: Install 8 boosters in a single Bionic Duplicant.

achievements.name: Blast Line of Defense
achievements.desc: Escape extinction by fulfilling the requirements of the Defense Imperative.

achievements.name: Cosmic Archaeology
achievements.desc: Uncover the past to secure your future by fulfilling the requirements of the Exploration Imperative.

achievements.name: Mine the Gap
achievements.desc: Mine 1,000,000kg from space POIs.

achievements.name: GMO A-OK
achievements.desc: Successfully analyze at least one seed of all mutatable plants.

achievements.name: Full Steam Ahead
achievements.desc: Secure your colony's industrial future by fulfilling the Power Imperative.

achievements.name: Data Driven
achievements.desc: Produce a Data Bank using a Data Miner operating at maximum efficiency.

achievements.name: The Lab: Life Found A Way
achievements.desc: Survive 100 cycles after Demolior collides with your colony.

achievements.name: Better Together
achievements.desc: Recruit the only freediver Duplicant in the universe to your colony.
